metaDescription: Bondo builds and tests custom PCs, and stocks the laptops, components and accessories to go with them. Three-year warranty.

hero.eyebrow: For people who read the spec sheet
hero.title: You pick the parts. We prove they work.
hero.body: Every build gets 24 hours on the bench before it ships. The thermal and stability numbers come in the box, for your machine rather than the model.
hero.panelBody: On the bench, at full load, before anything gets boxed.

featured.title: Popular right now
featured.description: The builds and parts customers are ordering most this month.

deals.title: Deals
deals.description: Prices go back to list when a promotion ends.
deals.emptyDescription: New promotions go up at the start of each month.

valueProps.title: Why buy from Bondo
valueProps.description: Four things you can hold us to.

tested.title: Burned in before it ships
tested.body: A full day of thermal and stability testing. If a build is going to throttle or drop out, it does it here and not on your desk.

answers.title: Answers with numbers in them
answers.body: Ask whether a cooler clears tall memory and you get the height in millimetres and the clearance to the first slot.

packed.title: Packed for the trip
packed.body: Graphics cards are double-boxed with the connector supported. Nothing rattles.

returns.title: Thirty-day returns
returns.body: Changed your mind, or picked the wrong socket? Send it back unused and we refund it.

reviews.title: What customers say
reviews.description: Only verified orders can leave a review.

newsletter.title: Back-in-stock alerts
newsletter.body: Tell us what you're waiting on and we'll email you the day it lands.
newsletter.note: Two emails a month at most. We never share your address.
